rca of the issue: AdminMail Reply-button bug root cause CONFIRMED and FIXED. Iter-31 RCA was correct: open() was calling load() at the end which triggered a fresh 10s IMAP fetch on every mail-item click, and the closure/state race caused the setSelected from open() to be effectively overwritten (or the UI stayed on 'Pilih pesan…' because the message list re-mounted before the detail pane could render). Fix: replaced the load() call inside open() with an in-place patch of the message row's unread flag + optimistic setSelected. Verification this run: network listener captured exactly ONE request to /admin/mail/messages/imap-19 immediately after click (no re-fetch of the whole inbox), mail-detail pane visible within 500ms, mail-reply-btn clickable, compose modal opens with 'Re: <original subject>' + quoted body.
